nodes.name: app-contracts
nodes.summary: Desktop app: shared IPC and ism type contracts
nodes.body:
The typed IPC channel table (invoke + push, with compile-time coverage
assertions, gitify-style) and a hand-written mirror of ism's serde
types. Fixtures captured from the real ism binary guard the mirror
against contract drift. Design: D23/D24.

nodes.name: app-services
nodes.body:
Injectable exec wrapper; git service (porcelain v2 + trailer-aware log
parsers, exported pure for tests); ism service mapping CLI JSON and
stable error codes onto the app's uniform Result; pty sessions with
Hyper-style 16ms/200KB batching and 36-char id-prefixed payloads;
project registry and settings persisted under userData. All IPC
handlers register through the typed contract table.

nodes.name: app-shell
nodes.summary: Desktop app: Electron shell, preload bridge, toolchain
nodes.body:
electron-vite + TypeScript strict + vitest (node & happy-dom
projects). The preload exposes exactly the IsomerApi contract via
contextBridge — contextIsolation on, no node in the renderer. A
headless ISOMER_SMOKE=1 boot path prints a marker after all three
processes load, for CI and scripted proof.

nodes.name: app-ui
nodes.summary: Desktop app: renderer shell in the Codex-minimal style
nodes.body:
Four-column layout (project rail / stack / review / inspector) plus a
terminal drawer wired to the pty bridge (@xterm/xterm + fit). Design
tokens as CSS variables with light/dark parity enforced by test;
i18next with en and zh-CN locales kept key-identical by test; zustand
store with the IPC bridge faked in unit tests. Design: D25/09.

nodes.name: app-ci
nodes.summary: Wire the desktop app into CI and document apps/
nodes.body:
Ubuntu job: npm ci (electron binary download skipped), typecheck,
vitest, electron-vite build. apps/README reflects the D23 decision:
Electron over the CLI JSON contract, replacing the old Tauri note.
